notes.text: EtherChannel Lab 10 - Golden Rule: configure the Po, never the members. WRONG: int f0/3 -> switchport trunk allowed vlan 1,20 => %EC-5-CANNOT_BUNDLE2, F0/3 suspended (s), Po1 still SU = silent 33% bandwidth loss. RIGHT: int port-channel 1 -> switchport trunk allowed vlan 1,10 => inherited by all members. Verify: show run int f0/3. PC1 192.168.10.1, PC2 .2 (VLAN 10).
